_note: Example archive missions demonstrating the mission/pinning flow. Replace with your own data.

missions.title: US Constitution — Congressional Archive (Example)
missions.desc: Government-hosted copies of important documents sometimes go offline or move. This example demonstrates ensuring the document doesn't exist only at one official URL.
missions.why: Constitutional documents are primary targets for erasure. Every copy is a vote for historical record.
missions.pin_guide: Paste the CID into Pinata (free tier), Filebase, or your local IPFS node.

missions.title: Open Government Spending Dataset (Example)
missions.desc: Public datasets sometimes get taken offline, reorganized, or quietly edited. This mission demonstrates mirroring a public dataset before that happens.
missions.why: Accountability data — once deleted, historical records disappear from public reference.
missions.pin_guide: Download the dataset, pin it to IPFS, and share your CID in Guardian Chat.

missions.title: From Dictatorship to Democracy — Gene Sharp
missions.desc: Foundational guide to nonviolent resistance. Used by democracy movements in 30+ countries. Must survive indefinitely.
missions.why: This document has helped topple dictatorships. It must never be unavailable.
missions.pin_guide: Download the PDF, add to IPFS, verify the CID matches, pin and share.

missions.title: Security Advisories Archive (Example)
missions.desc: Public security bulletins and advisories are a good example of institutional knowledge worth mirroring — agencies reorganize, pages move, and links rot.
missions.why: Security advisories protect critical infrastructure. Their disappearance leaves communities blind.
missions.pin_guide: Use a web archiving tool to capture the advisory pages, then pin the archive file to IPFS.

missions.title: Community-Submitted Evidence Archive (Example)
missions.desc: A generic example of crowd-sourced evidence preservation — firsthand accounts and documentation submitted by a community and preserved regardless of who controls the official record.
missions.why: Those who control the archive control the history. Distribute the copies.
missions.pin_guide: Submit documented evidence via Guardian Chat. Include source URL and date.
